newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China's Jiangxi Paper plans to issue A shares.
newsitem.headline: China's Jiangxi Paper plans to issue A shares.

text.p: Jiangxi Paper Industry Co Ltd, a press paper maker, plans to apply for an offer of 50 million A shares this year but has not decided where to apply to list the stock, a company spokesman said on Friday.
China Securities Co Ltd will be the offer's lead underwriter and Jiangxi Paper's listing promoter, he told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
The issue, the pricing of which has yet to be fixed, requires the final approval of the China Securities Regulatory Commission, the official said.
Based in Nanchang, capital of southeastern Jiangxi province, the company has 60 million outstanding shares all owned by the state, the official said.
Jiangxi Paper aims to use the share proceeds to double its paper-making capacity to 200,000 tonnes annually by 1999, he added.
